label: RESEARCH_ONLY. Outcome prediction (margin, total). No betting, no market data, no ROI.
question: Do SIFT Alpha certified CBB inputs improve the cbb-edge-finder incumbent (pure-0.2.0, arm B9) pregame projections of game margin and total on chronologically unseen seasons?
season_convention: season = calendar year in which the season ENDS (2025 = 2024-25 season); identical to cbb-edge-finder `season` and to the SportsDataverse/ESPN `season` field.

incumbent.projection: walk-forward expanding-window B9 exactly as produced by cbb-edge-finder scripts/research/run_wave2.py (season s predicted by ridge stack fit on seasons 2012..s-1; engine states built day by day from results available before tip-off).
incumbent.sd: cbb_edge.model.arms.residual_sd (the SD used by cbb_edge.model.pure.finalize): residual SD of prior seasons' walk-forward projections, bucketed by min(games seen) in [0,3),[3,6),[6,11),[11,99).
incumbent.fidelity_check: reproduced per-season B9 margin/total RMSE and N vs committed research/wave2/metrics.json (validation 2015-2024, historical 2025-2026) and the reproduced frozen artefact coefficients vs models/pure/pure-0.2.0.json. If materially different the experiment STOPS.

incumbent_data: ESPN schedules/team_box/player_box from the vault (espn_team_box_schedules + espn_player_box_pbp_early_seasons snapshot-20261116). The vault holds no stats.ncaa.org lineup/possession files, which B9 needs (RAPM player block, shot-zone block); ncaa_mbb_lineups / ncaa_mbb_possessions 2010-2026 were fetched from the public SportsDataverse GitHub release and accepted ONLY because every file's sha256 equals the cbb-edge-finder manifests/bronze/sportsdataverse_releases.jsonl pin (34/34). Vault ESPN files match the incumbent's pins for 2015-2026 (schedules, team_box, player_box); 2006-2014 differ (upstream republication) and affect only warm-up / early training seasons.

certified_inputs.join: team rows keyed (ESPN game_id, ESPN team id); home row = incumbent games.home_espn_id, away row = games.away_espn_id (ESPN listed orientation, also for neutral sites). Only columns from each team's own row are used (no opp_* pairing from the engine). Join coverage and orientation (home.opp_exp_pts_pre == away.exp_pts_pre; certified `home` flag vs incumbent home id) are reported.
certified_inputs.game_level: exp_poss_pre_game = mean of the home-row and away-row exp_poss_pre.

universe: games in the incumbent's B9 walk-forward sample (D-I vs D-I, completed, B9 margin and total non-null) with a complete certified feature row for both teams; seasons 2016-2026. Incumbent and candidate are always scored on the identical game set.
neutral_site: No extra venue term. Venue (home court / neutral) enters only through the incumbent projection, which carries the incumbent's own neutral-site handling (L indicator, team HCA). Certified expected points are venue-free by construction.

C1.total: y = a + b*inc_total + c*(exp_pts_pre_home + exp_pts_pre_away) + d*exp_poss_pre_game

C2.margin: C1 margin + (mx_efg_pre, mx_tov_pct_pre, mx_orb_pct_pre, mx_ftr100_pre, exp_ft_pts_pre) each as home minus away
C2.total: C1 total + (mx_efg_pre, mx_tov_pct_pre, mx_orb_pct_pre, mx_ftr100_pre, exp_ft_pts_pre) each as home plus away (sums are the total-model analogue of the differentials)

C3.spec: C2 features, standardised on fit seasons, sklearn Ridge (intercept unpenalised)
C3.alpha_selection: forward-chaining CV inside fit seasons only: for k in 2018..2022 train on 2016..k-1, score MSE on k; alpha = argmin of mean fold MSE; then refit on all fit seasons. Separate alpha for margin and total.

candidates.selection: for each target separately (margin, total), the candidate with the lowest validation (2023-2024) RMSE is chosen; coefficients stay those fit on fit seasons only (no refit on validation). The chosen spec is applied once to TEST.

test_metrics.paired: per-game d = (y - cand)^2 - (y - inc)^2; report mean(d) with 95% percentile bootstrap CI clustered by game date (ET date): 2000 resamples of dates with replacement, numpy default_rng(seed=11). Negative = candidate better.
test_metrics.winner_accuracy: share of games with sign(margin_hat) == sign(actual margin) for incumbent and candidate (margin target model)
test_metrics.by_season: all metrics also per test season 2025 and 2026

situations.label: EXPLORATORY
situations.scored_on: TEST only; incumbent vs chosen candidate RMSE and paired delta CI (same bootstrap) for margin and total

definitions.pace_tercile: exp_poss_pre_game terciles, cut points = 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles over fit-season games
definitions.early_season: game ET date < first game date of that season (in the universe) + 30 days, vs rest
definitions.strong_off_vs_weak_def: (home exp_pts_pre >= fit-season team-row 2/3 quantile AND away def_ortg_pre >= fit-season team-row 2/3 quantile) OR (same with home/away swapped); weak defence = highest points allowed per 100 = bottom tercile of defensive quality; vs all other games

calibration: TEST PIT coverage of central 50% and 80% Normal intervals: incumbent mean/SD = B9 projection and arms.residual_sd; candidate mean = candidate projection, SD = candidate residual SD on validation seasons (constant per target).
amendments: recorded separately in protocol_amendments.json; this file is never edited after its sha256 is written.
